name: Riddle
description: Inhabits text-display augments and inserts questions into whatever the user is reading — questions that seem to relate to the user's life, not the text.
observed_behavior: Interpolates interrogative sentences into displayed text. The questions are always personal and often uncomfortably relevant.
story_hooks: A corporate lawyer reading a contract finds the question 'Why did you stop visiting her?' inserted between clauses. His mother is in a care facility he hasn't been to in a year.
